name: print-social-earth-water-fire-element-posters-with-decorative-display-type
title: Earth, Water and Fire element posters with ornate display type hanging on binder clips
whatItIs: Three portrait posters clipped to strings on black: 'EARTH' with a woman crowned in gold roots and a gold ornamental display face, 'WATER' in icy blue, 'FIRE' in red, each with small vertical text and a tagline like 'Rooted in power'.
whatItMeans: Mythic and dramatic; each element gets its own colour world within one typographic system.
techniques: Build a series by swapping colour per theme.
Use an ornamental display typeface for fantasy.
Hang posters on clips for a gallery mockup.

vocabulary.definition: Shared layout rules across a set of designs.
A decorative font meant for large sizes.
